title: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE Hood Paint and Grille Replacement
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair repainted the hood and replaced the front grille on a 2017 Toyota Camry XSE.
story: This 2017 Toyota Camry XSE came to the shop for hood refinishing and front grille service. The work required repainting the entire hood panel and installing a replacement front grille. Hood painting requires detailed surface preparation, including sanding down clear coat damage or imperfections and thorough cleaning before painting.

Once prep work is complete, primer and color base coats are sprayed in a controlled environment. A clear coat layer is applied to protect the finish against UV rays and weathering. Installing the new front grille requires aligning mounting tabs and clips with the front bumper cover and surrounding trim panels to ensure factory gaps.
